title: Crowding Effects on the Structure and Dynamics of the Intrinsically Disordered Nuclear Chromatin Protein NUPR1.
authors: Bonucci, Alessio; Palomino-Schatzlein, Martina; Malo de Molina, Paula; Arbe, Arantxa; Pierattelli, Roberta; Rizzuti, Bruno; Iovanna, Juan L; Neira, Jose L
one_liner_zh: 该文研究拥挤环境对无序核染色质蛋白NUPR1结构与动态的影响，涉及DNA结合相关蛋白但未聚焦TF-DNA互作建模，且方法为光谱实验而非AI或物理模拟，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The intracellular environment is crowded with macromolecules, including sugars, proteins and nucleic acids. In the cytoplasm, crowding effects are capable of excluding up to 40% of the volume available to any macromolecule when compared to dilute conditions. NUPR1 is an intrinsically disordered protein (IDP) involved in cell-cycle regulation, stress-cell response, apoptosis processes, DNA binding and repair, chromatin remodeling and transcription. Simulations of molecular crowding predict that IDPs can adopt compact states, as well as more extended conformations under crowding conditions. In this work, we analyzed the conformation and dynamics of NUPR1 in the presence of two synthetic polymers, Ficoll-70 and Dextran-40, which mimic crowding effects in the cells, at two different concentrations (50 and 150 mg/ml). The study was carried out by using a multi-spectroscopic approach, including: site-directed spin labelling electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy (SDSL-EPR), nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy (NMR), circular dichroism (CD), small angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) and dynamic light scattering (DLS). SDSL-EPR spectra of two spin-labelled mutants indicate that there was binding with the crowders and that the local dynamics of the C and N termini of NUPR1 were partially affected by the crowders. However, the overall disordered nature of NUPR1 did not change substantially in the presence of the crowders, as shown by circular dichroism CD and NMR, and further confirmed by EPR. The changes in the dynamics of the paramagnetic probes appear to be related to preferred local conformations and thus crowding agents partially affect some specific regions, further pinpointing that NUPR1 flexibility has a key physiological role in its activity.
abstract_zh: 细胞内环境拥挤着大分子，包括糖类、蛋白质和核酸。在细胞质中，与稀释条件相比，拥挤效应能够排除任何大分子可用体积的多达40%。NUPR1是一种固有无序蛋白 (intrinsically disordered protein, IDP)，参与细胞周期调控、应激细胞反应、凋亡过程、DNA结合与修复、染色质重塑和转录。分子拥挤的模拟预测，IDPs在拥挤条件下可以呈现紧凑状态，以及更伸展的构象。在本研究中，我们分析了NUPR1在两种合成聚合物Ficoll-70和Dextran-40存在下的构象和动力学，这些聚合物模拟细胞内的拥挤效应，并在两种不同浓度（50和150 mg/ml）下进行。研究采用多光谱方法，包括：定点自旋标记电子顺磁共振波谱 (site-directed spin labelling electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy, SDSL-EPR)、核磁共振波谱 (nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, NMR)、圆二色光谱 (circular dichroism, CD)、小角X射线散射 (small angle X-ray scattering, SAXS) 和动态光散射 (dynamic light scattering, DLS)。两个自旋标记突变体的SDSL-EPR谱表明，与拥挤剂存在结合，且NUPR1的C端和N端的局部动力学部分受到拥挤剂影响。然而，NUPR1的整体无序性质在拥挤剂存在下并未发生显著变化，如圆二色光谱CD和NMR所示，并进一步通过EPR确认。顺磁探针动力学的变化似乎与优先局部构象相关，因此拥挤剂部分影响某些特定区域，进一步指出NUPR1的灵活性在其活性中具有关键的生理作用。
